```{r}

CDR_full <- function() {
  file <- here::here("data/raw/cdr_full.nc")
  years <- 1981:2023
  
  if (file.exists(file)) {
    return(file)
  }
  
  urls <- paste0(
    "https://polarwatch.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/nsidcG02202v4sh1day.nc?cdr_seaice_conc[(",
    years,
    "-01-01T00:00:00Z):1:(",
    years,
    "-12-31T00:00:00Z)][(4350000.0):1:(-3950000.0)][(-3950000.0):1:(3950000.0)]"
  )
  
  files <- replicate(length(urls), tempfile())
  res <- curl::multi_download(urls, files, resume = TRUE)
  
  files |>
    rcdo::cdo_mergetime() |>
    cdo_chname("cdr_seaice_conc", "aice") |>
    cdo_del29feb() |>
    rcdo::cdo_setgrid(CDR_grid()) |>
    rcdo::cdo_execute(output = file, options = c("-L", "-O"))
  
  remove(files)
  return(file)
}
```


```{r}
process <- function(files, output) {
  return_if_exists(output)
  
  files |> 
    furrr::future_map(\(file) {
      file |> 
        cdo_remapbil(CDR_grid()) |> 
        cdo_execute(tempfile(), options = c("-L", "-s"))
    }, .progress = TRUE) |> 
    cdo_mergetime() |> 
    cdo_execute(output, options = c("-L", "-s"))
}
```

```{r}
cdo_anomalies <- function(file) {
  cdo_ymonsub(file, cdo_ymonmean(file))
}
```

```{r}

polygon_area <- function(x, y) {
  # Ensure the polygon is closed (last point equals first point)
  if (x[1] != x[length(x)] || y[1] != y[length(y)]) {
    x <- c(x, x[1])
    y <- c(y, y[1])
  }
  
  n <- length(x)
  area <- 0
  
  # Apply the Shoelace formula
  for (i in 1:(n-1)) {
    area <- area + (x[i] * y[i+1] - x[i+1] * y[i])
  }
  
  # Take absolute value and divide by 2
  return(abs(area) / 2)
}
```

```{r}
library(sf)




point_in_polygon <- function(point_x, point_y, polygon_x, polygon_y) {
  # Create a simple feature polygon
  polygon_sf <- sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(polygon_x, polygon_y)))
  
  # Create simple feature points
  points_sf <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_multipoint(cbind(point_x, point_y)))
  
  # Convert to sf objects with the same CRS
  polygon_sf <- sf::st_sfc(polygon_sf, crs = 4326)
  points_sf <- sf::st_sfc(points_sf, crs = 4326)
  
  # Use st_intersects to check if points are inside the polygon
  result <- sf::st_intersects(sf::st_cast(points_sf, "POINT"), polygon_sf, sparse = FALSE)
  
  return(result[,1])
}
```




```{r}
points <- cors_sst_era5 |>
  ReadNetCDF("t2m") |>
  _[t2m != -1] |> 
  _[month(time) %between% c(5, 10)] |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("xgrid", "ygrid")) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(time) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(geometry = st_combine(geometry)) 


positives_polygon <- positives |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y")) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(time) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(geometry = st_combine(geometry)) |> 
  st_cast("POLYGON") 

sf::st_within()

positive_points <- dplyr::left_join(
  points |> 
    dplyr::as_tibble(),
  positives_polygon |> 
    dplyr::as_tibble(),
  by = "time") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(geometry = st_intersection(geometry.y, geometry.x), .by = time) |>
  dplyr::reframe(as.data.frame(st_coordinates(geometry)), .by  = time) |> 
  as.data.table() |> 
  _[, .(month = month(time), xgrid = X, ygrid = Y)]

```


```{r}
bad_place <-  list(xgrid = -1e6, 
                   ygrid = 2.3e6,
                   time = c("1981-01-01", "2023-12-01"))

good_place <-  list(xgrid = -2.3e6, 
                    ygrid = 2.3e6,
                    time = c("1981-01-01", "2023-12-01"))


bad_ice <- rbind(era5 = ice_era5 |> 
                   ReadNetCDF(c(aice = "siconc"), subset = bad_place) ,
                 nsicd = CDR_full() |> 
                   cdo_monmean() |> 
                   cdo_setday(1) |> 
                   cdo_execute() |> 
                   ReadNetCDF(c("aice"), subset = bad_place),
                 idcol = "dataset")  

good_ice <- rbind(era5 = ice_era5 |> 
                    ReadNetCDF(c(aice = "siconc"), subset = good_place) ,
                  nsicd = CDR_full() |> 
                    cdo_monmean() |> 
                    cdo_setday(1) |> 
                    cdo_execute() |> 
                    ReadNetCDF(c("aice"), subset = good_place),
                  idcol = "dataset")  

rbind(positive = good_ice, negative = bad_ice, idcol = "location") |> 
  _[, aice := aice - mean(aice), by = .(location, dataset, month(time))] |> 
  _[month(time) %in% c(4, 7)] |> 
  _[, month := lubridate::month(time, label = TRUE)] |> 
  ggplot(aes(time, aice)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = dataset)) +
  facet_wrap(month ~ location, scales = "free")

```
